barks.text: Have you seen the lab Pokémon?
Up with the Pidgey, as always.
Look at that sky — all orange.
The berries will love this rain.

talk.text: I peek into Oak's lab every day. One day he'll give ME a Pokémon.
Take good care of your partner. I peek into Oak's lab every day. One day he'll give ME a Pokémon.
